# Notes beside the tabs

The second file of [the tabs fixture](reopen-tabs-323.md): something to
leave open, to pin, and to find again or not at the next start.

## A list to read

- One window, **three** tabs
  - this one in the middle
  - `Ctrl+Tab` goes to the next
- Close the window, *not* the tabs

| Tab     | Pinned | Comes back with the setting off |
|---------|:------:|---------------------------------|
| fixture |   no   | no                              |
| notes   |  yes   | yes                             |
| log     |   no   | no                              |

> Closing every tab by hand before closing the window is what the
> request wanted to be spared.

```text
tab=C:\notes\reopen-tabs-323-notes.md
pinnedTab=C:\notes\reopen-tabs-323-notes.md
```
